item.description: A resident of Mekelle says the city is calm but people are stressed after the outbreak of fighting in the region.

item.title: Watch: Why is the UK reviewing its Chagos Islands deal?
item.description: The UK is reviewing its deal to hand over the Chagos Islands to Mauritius, the defence secretary has said.

item.title: Inside Djibouti refugee camp for thousands fleeing Houthi advance in Yemen
item.description: Fighting on Yemen's west coast has prompted thousands of people to flee by boat across the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
